Part A
TIME: 15 minutes

Look at the four texts, A-D, in the separate Reading Part A: Text Booklet.
For each question, 1-20, look through the texts A-D, to find the relevant information.
Type your answers in the Answer box provided.
Answer all the quesons wi thi n the 15 -minute time limit.
Your answers should be spelled correctly.


For each of the questions, 1 – 7, decide which text (A, B, C or D) the information comes
from. You may use any letter more than once.

Answer: ……………………………….……………………

Question 13
Question text

Answer: ……………………………….……………………




Questions 14 - 20

Complete the sentences, in questions 14-20, with a word or short phrase from one of the
texts. Each answer may include words, numbers or both. Your answers should be spelled
correctly.

Question 14
Question text

Self reporting is considered to be ……………………………….……………………when measure pain in children.

Question 15
Question text

You should avoid using ……………………………….……………………observations on their own as a way of
measuring pain.

Question 16
Question text

You should ensure the patient understands they need to choose the ……………………………….………… that
most accurately represents their mood when self reporting.

Question 17
Question text

Don’t have patients self report if they lack the required ……………………………….…………………ability

Question 18
Question text

Make sure to allocate a score of between ……………………………….………………… for each sub-group when
evaluating the behavioural responses of a child.
 
Question 19
Question text

The maximum possible pain score should be given to a patient if you notice it is hard
to……………………………….…………………them.

Question 20
Question text

Pain should be assessed and recorded ……………………………….……………………analgesia.
